name: AWS Serverless & Infrastructure Auto-Architect
description: Monitors .NET C# and Python application code to synthesize least-privilege AWS CDK TypeScript constructs and detect IAM security drift.

commands.name: /auto-architect scan
commands.description: Scan workspace for AWS SDK calls (.NET and Python) and display detected IAM permissions

commands.name: /auto-architect apply
commands.description: Synthesize least-privilege AWS CDK constructs and merge non-destructively into the target stack

commands.name: /auto-architect drift
commands.description: Check for orphaned IAM permissions in the target CDK stack

tools.name: scan_workspace
tools.description: Scans .NET C# and Python files in the workspace to detect AWS SDK operations and identify required IAM permissions.

workspaceDir.description: Root directory of the workspace to scan.

tools.name: generate_cdk_snippet
tools.description: Synthesizes TypeScript AWS CDK statements (least-privilege IAM policies, Table.fromTableArn, bucket ARNs) from detected calls.

calls.description: List of detected AWS SDK calls.

tools.name: apply_to_stack
tools.description: Merges synthesized CDK constructs into an existing CDK stack between [kiro-power:start] and [kiro-power:end] tags.

stackFile.description: Path to the target CDK stack TypeScript file.

tools.name: check_drift
tools.description: Audits the CDK stack against current codebase to detect orphaned IAM permissions that are no longer actively used.

stackFile.description: Path to the target CDK stack TypeScript file.
